acceptanceTests.title: StateValidation sources testFramework from TestSpecification
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that resume validation uses testFramework from accepted TestSpecification rather than hardcoded 'vitest'.
acceptanceTests.expectedBehavior: StateValidation passes resume validation when testFramework matches TestSpecification; fails when mismatched.

acceptanceTests.title: StateValidation sources executionCommand from TestSpecification
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that resume validation uses executionCommand from accepted TestSpecification rather than hardcoded 'npm test'.
acceptanceTests.expectedBehavior: StateValidation passes resume validation when executionCommand matches TestSpecification; fails when mismatched.
acceptanceTests.failureCondition: StateValidation hardcodes 'npm test' and ignores TestSpecification.executionCommand.

acceptanceTests.title: RealDeterministicTestRunner uses TestSpecification framework/command
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that the test runner uses testFramework and executionCommand from TestSpecification rather than request parameters or hardcoded values.
acceptanceTests.expectedBehavior: TestRunner executes using framework and command from TestSpecification.
acceptanceTests.failureCondition: TestRunner ignores TestSpecification and uses hardcoded or request-supplied values.

acceptanceTests.title: TestSuiteHasher uses TestSpecification values for canonicalization
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that hash calculation incorporates testFramework and executionCommand from TestSpecification bundle.
acceptanceTests.expectedBehavior: Different framework/command values produce different hashes for identical test content.
acceptanceTests.failureCondition: Hash ignores framework/command, making it impossible to detect authority drift.

acceptanceTests.title: Resume validation works with new authority model
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that resume validation correctly validates TestSuiteLock against TestSpecification with framework and command fields.
acceptanceTests.expectedBehavior: Resume validation succeeds when all TestSpecification fields match TestSuiteLock; fails on any mismatch.
acceptanceTests.failureCondition: Resume validation ignores framework/command or fails when they match.

acceptanceTests.title: Full regression: all tests pass after authority changes
acceptanceTests.description: Verify that all existing and new tests pass after TestSpecification authority changes.
acceptanceTests.failureCondition: Any test fails after TestSpecification authority changes.
